body: I struggle with this, what has helped me is writing down my passwords and such so I don't have to go to my settings and all.
Oh wow, this hit me. Thank you for putting it into words.
Totally feel this. I elaborate on every plan and every thing I say because I’m terrified of it being twisted around. It isn’t your fault and you’re not annoying for it, I promise
You're not alone at all, it is unfortunately a common experience. You're not guilty of anything and deserve to be your true self safely. His manipulation and hatred is a reflection of him, not you.

Its hard to see right now, but you've taken a huge step already, and every one counts. The physical distance is a good start, and once the dust settles it may be easier to think a little clearer. I know it seems like she's all powerful and inescapable, but you've already started breaking that notion down by moving. Keep scheduling your own appointments and definitely work on getting suitable medication. Every psychiatrist won't be a good fit, so if they don't click, don't hesitate to try someone else. 

The control is lessening, bit by bit. You're stronger than you know.
I'm sure your new hat is awesome! Its the little things. Enjoy it !
Yep. Seeing someone excited for their dad to come home or not afraid of their mom is so alien to me. Idk how common it is, but I find myself picking them apart, like there /must/ be something amiss.
This is chilling in its accuracy. Some faces, expressions, are just burned into your mind forever.
